✦ Platform Governance

Terms of Service

Effective Date: October 27, 2026

1. Scope & Eligibility

Welcome to ASTRAVEN. By accessing, registering, or depositing capital into the ASTRAVEN platform, you acknowledge and agree to be legally bound by these Terms of Service. Membership is strictly open to individuals aged 18 and older possessing valid Nigerian identification and bank custody accounts.

2. Account Security & Custody

You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials, passwords, and two-factor access tokens. ASTRAVEN staff will never ask for your password. Any transaction executed via your authenticated credentials is deemed authorized.

3. Product Terms & Settlements

ASTRA-VIP, SSVIP, and Limited Route products are governed by explicit digital contracts:

  • ASTRA-VIP: Daily income settles directly to your wallet across the configured 50-calendar-day cycle.
  • SSVIP: Operates on fixed-term maturity rails where capital and profit are credited together at term end.
  • Limited Products: Subject to strict commercial aircraft seat quotas. Purchases close immediately when capacity is reached.

4. Manual Deposits & Banking Rails

Manual deposits must be transferred directly to the designated commercial settlement account shown in your portal. Proofs of payment are reviewed during operational hours (08:00 to 22:00 WAT). Submitting fraudulent transfer references constitutes grounds for immediate account suspension.

5. Withdrawals & Applicable Fees

Withdrawals are subject to the current minimum threshold (₦3,000) and the configured 5% administrative fee. Funds are reserved atomically upon request to prevent concurrent double-spending. Payments settle directly into your verified Nigerian bank account.

6. Affiliate Program & Referral VIP

Direct referral commissions are set at 10% of verified qualifying downline deposits. Self-referrals, synthetic account rings, and cross-line registrations are monitored and will trigger automatic commission clawbacks and account termination.

7. Contact & Support

For regulatory inquiries or platform disputes, submit a formal support ticket through the Customer Service portal.
